programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Side Story! Clash! Luffy vs. the King of Carbonation!
programme.desc: Luffy and Boa Hancock square off against the Cidre Guild! These unscrupulous bounty hunters have one thing in mind - profit at any cost! When the battle looks won, Cidre gears up in a menacing power suit!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Save Otama! Straw Hat, Bounding through the Wasteland!
programme.desc: Otama recounts her promise to Ace while Luffy rushes her to medical attention. But just as they reach the wasteland, a familiar face comes into view! But Kaido's underlings show up too!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Headliner! Hawkins the Magician Appears!
programme.desc: Otama's temperature is going up and Luffy has no time to waste! However, Hawkins, one of Kaido's Headliners, blocks their way by showing his unique powers and skills which can harm his own men.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Defeat is Inevitable! The Strawman's Fierce Attack!
programme.desc: Luffy and Zoro have been stalled by Hawkins but their fortune looks bright as they are guided by a woman who Zoro had saved. She leads them to a teahouse and to an herbal remedy for the river poison.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Greatest Day of My Life! Otama and Her Sweet Red-bean Soup!
programme.desc: Otama's life is saved by Otsuru at her teahouse. The proud Otama finds it hard to take more kindness. The group learns of the Okobore Town - living on the cast-offs of the officials! Then, suddenly, they were attacked by the Shogun's men!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Charging into the Enemy's Territory! Bakura Town - Where Officials Thrive!
programme.desc: Otama has been kidnapped by the Gifters! She is taken to a flourishing town called Bakura Town where a creepy-looking Headliner was expecting her. Luffy and Zoro rush to rescue her along with a samurai, Okiku!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Yokozuna Appears! The Invincible Urashima Goes After Okiku!
programme.desc: As Luffy, Zoro, and Okiku bounce through Bakura Town on Komachiyo's back, a sumo wrestler comes flying towards them! Interested, they go down to watch sumo but the undefeated yokozuna Urashima has been expecting Okiku there.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Climactic Sumo Battle! Straw Hat vs. the Strongest Ever Yokozuna!
programme.desc: Luffy challenges Urashima, the strongest yokozuna in the Land of Wano, to a sumo match! Urashima even uses illegal moves to beat Luffy at any cost! Meanwhile, Holdem tells Otama that he knows she committed a crime and he has to punish her for it.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Luffy Rages! Rescue Otama from Danger!
programme.desc: After sending the yokozuna Urashima flying, Luffy and his clan continue their search for Bakura Town's boss to save Otama! They finally find the boss, Holdem, one of the Beast Pirates' Headliners.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Taking Back Otama! A Fierce Fight Against Holdem!
programme.desc: Facing Holdem who is holding Otama as hostage, Luffy prepares for a fight but Okiku tries to stop him by sharing who is really ruling the region. Meanwhile, Basil Hawkins is confronted by a mysterious figure.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Duel! The Magician and the Surgeon of Death!
programme.desc: Taking down Holdem, Luffy rescues Otama and tries to catch up to Zoro and Okiku who stole the food treasure ship and started a mad dash to get out of the town!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: This is a story of Luffy in an alternate reality. While sailing on the sea by himself, a strange bird crashes into his small boat. He looks up to find a giant ship where a girl named Ann has been captured. It seems like the bird belongs to her.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Coming of the Treasure Ship! LuffytaroReturns the Favor!
programme.desc: Zoro and the others dash out of BakuraTown on the treasure ship filled with food! Luffy catches up to them bringing ahuge bucket of fresh water! Then, they distribute the food and the water to thepeople of Okobore Town who were thirsty and hungry.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Mysterious Grave Markers! A Reunion at the Ruins of Oden Castle!
programme.desc: Luffy arrives at the ruins of Oden Castle following Law and finds the graves of his friends, Kin'emon and the others. As Law starts telling the already-stunned Luffy about the creepy story of Kin'emon's ghost, Luffy sees it coming towards him!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Legendary Samurai! The Man Who Roger Admired!
programme.desc: Kin'emon tells Luffy and the others about how Kozuki Oden made Kuri into a peaceful region and became its Daimyo. However, he was set up by Kaido and Kurozumi Orochi and executed.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Bringing Down the Emperor of the Sea! A Secret Raid Operation Begins!
programme.desc: Kin'emon and the others crossed through time by the power of Kozuki Toki, Momonosuke's mother, and arrived at the Land of Wano 20 years later, a totally different country before their eyes.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Strongest Man in the World! Shutenmaru, the Thieves Brigade Chief!
programme.desc: Ashura Doji, one of the allies Kin'emon wants to search for, has become the head of a thieves brigade and they now raid Okobore Town taking away the food that Luffy gave to the people.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Everyone is Annihilated! Kaido's Furious Blast Breath!
programme.desc: The drunken Kaido flies above Okobore Town in his dragon form and threatens Shutenmaru and all the people in the town. Luffy, Law, Kin'emon, and Okiku start running towards the town to rescue them.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Finally Clashing! The Ferocious Luffy vs. Kaido!
programme.desc: After Luffy sees Kaido shattering the ruins of Oden Castle where he left his friends, he becomes enraged and attacks Kaido! Soon after, he finds out Kaido even assaulted Otama who was riding on Speed's back to her home.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Destructive! One Shot, One Kill – Thunder Bagua!
programme.desc: An infuriated Luffy strikes blow after blow on the drunken Kaido. When he activates Gear Four Bounce-Man and launches even more powerful attacks, Kaido fights back and knocks him out with just one blow.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Living Hell! Luffy, Humiliated in the Great Mine!
programme.desc: Luffy gets beaten by Kaido and is sent to a great mine where prisoners are made to work in forced labor. There, he finds an unexpected reunion. Meanwhile, Okiku is rushing to the ruins of Oden Castle.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Holyland in Tumult! Emperor of the Sea Blackbeard Cackles!
programme.desc: On Gloom Island in the Grand Line, Perona finds out that her captain, Gecko Moria, is alive and she is about to leave Dracule Mihawk who let her stay there for the last two years. Meanwhile,

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: It's On! The Special Operation to Bring Down Kaido!
programme.desc: Dogstorm fights against Shutenmaru to ally with him for their operation but Shutenmaru still rejects their call.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Rampage! The Prisoners – Luffy and Kid!
programme.desc: In the Excavation Labor Camp, Luffy competes against Kid by hauling stones for food and they both get tons of it. However, Dobon, a vice warden, becomes furious when he finds out all their provisions are gone, and gives Luffy and Kid a new sentence.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Great Sensation! Sanji's Special Soba!
programme.desc: Sanji's Special Soba becomes very popular but some gang members come to disturb his business and knock over a customer's bowl. Infuriated, Sanji takes them down and gives the customer, a little girl named Toko.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Luxurious and Gorgeous! Wano's Most Beautiful Woman – Komurasaki!
programme.desc: Wano's top courtesan Komurasaki is in procession and slowly makes her way to Orochi Palace. There is a crowd of people on the street as well as Sanji and the others. While everyone is fascinated by her, some seeking vengeance get in the Oiran's way.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Tale of Chivalry! Zoro and Tonoyasu's Little Trip!
programme.desc: Zoro who has been wandering around the Land of Wano since he got separated from his friends meets a sycophant named Tonoyasu. Tonoyasu paid for Zoro's sushi and to pay him back, Zoro gambles at dice.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A State of Emergency! Big Mom Closes in!
programme.desc: Zoro is taken to the sycophant Tonoyasu's poor hometown, Ebisu Town where people laugh away their misfortune.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Capital in an Uproar! Another Assassin Targets Sanji!
programme.desc: As the Big Mom Pirates approach the Land of Wano, Kaido's subordinates led by King and Queen try to get rid of them.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji faces Page One, a Headliner of the Animal Kingdom Pirates, who questions the soba cook's true identity. Sanji uses Germa's device for the first time and transforms himself into Stealth Black while dubbing himself Soba Mask.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Desperate Situation! Orochi's Menacing Oniwabanshu!
programme.desc: While the banquet grows livelier at Orochi's Castle, Robin is confronted by his ninja force called Oniwabanshu. In the meanwhile in Kuri, Chopper, Tama, and Momonosuke train themselves preparing for the incoming battle.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Pandemonium! The Monster Snake, Shogun Orochi!
programme.desc: At the banquet, the Shogun Orochi starts to talk about his late old enemy which bores the attendees. Suddenly, the Oiran's child attendant Toko bursts with laughter and won't stop. Orochi becomes furious and attacks her.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Flower Falls! The Final Moment of the Most Beautiful Woman in the Land of Wano!
programme.desc: In order to save her child attendant Toko, the top Oiran Komurasaki stands up to the Shogun Orochi, but the yakuza boss Kyoshiro interrupts and does something that no one expected.

programme.title: Drop Zone
programme.desc: Greg Zipadelli, Zac Zipadelli, Hal Shaffer, and Barry Woods head to the sandhills of Nebraska in search of mule deer and whitetails.

programme.title: The Gamekeepers of Mossy Oak
programme.desc: On this episode, we are joined by Pastor Joby Martin, who explains his intense passion for hunting. We also learn how the woods and the outdoors play a huge role in inspiring his soul-stirring sermons and why he views it as an incredible way to reach men. As expected, it's a fun and enlightening conversation. Listen, Learn and Enjoy.

programme.title: The Bucks of Tecomate
programme.desc: Leupold's Bruce Petit hammers home a Highveld Trifecta — beards, horns, and antlers.

programme.title: Addicted to the Outdoors
programme.desc: Follow Raven and her friends on an unforgettable Key West trip to the Dry Tortugas where they learn the art of hand fishing, explore the local island culture, and come face-to-face with manta rays and sharks during an up-close aquarium diving experience.

programme.title: Offroad Odyssey
programme.desc: From Carolina to Appalachia, this is a classic Southeast adventure.

programme.title: Onx Hunt Gameday
programme.desc: Nate Akey heads to the chukar hills with dogs in tow, and then we join Steve Beaulieu in search of ducks along the river.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.desc: In Michigan, Steve joins spearfishing buddies Greg Fonts and Jonathan Durtka to challenge Seth Morris and Chester Floyd to an informal walleye fishing competition on Lake Huron; it's fishing rods versus spearguns, winner gets bragging rights.

programme.title: MeatEater's 12 in 26
programme.desc: Steven Rinella and Spencer Neuharth get their hands on a 7-foot, 140-year-old punt gun. Capable of bringing down over 100 birds with a single blast, these colossal shotguns pushed some waterfowl species to the brink.

programme.title: MeatEater's 12 in 26
programme.desc: Clay Newcomb opens Arkansas bear season with a camp steeped in tradition.

programme.title: MLF Team Series
programme.desc: ORIGINAL CONTENT - Four Teams compete in Shreveport, LA for Elimination Match 2 of the Summit Cup to advance to the Knockout Rounds.

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: A Tent Situation

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands: A Rivalry Revival
programme.desc: After Gary comes to the rescue against Team Rocket, Ash seizes an opportunity…at long last, our hero gets to challenge his rival to their very first Pokémon battle!

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: In a forest that's being destroyed by rampaging Pinsir, Ash has to enlist the help of the local Heracross to protect their home! But it turns out these Pokémon look tougher than they act…

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: The Pokémon League is about to begin with the ceremonial lighting of the torch, which carries a flame from the Legendary Pokémon Moltres. Of course, Team Rocket tries to steal it!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: Ash faces his toughest opponent yet on the Grass Field at the Pokémon League! Are he and his Bulbasaur ready to take on his opponent and her powerful Scyther?

programme.title: Pokémon 4Ever
programme.desc: Ash must stop a hunter who forces the mythical Pokémon Celebi to help him destroy a forest.

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: When Ash runs into his old rival Gary preparing to enter his Arcanine in a race, he decides to compete as well! But first, he’ll have to chase Team Rocket away from the Pokémon Day Care.

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: When the Pokémon Egg given to Ash goes missing, our heroes call on the help of a hapless Officer Jenny. It isn't long before they realize that if they want the Egg back, they'll have to find it themselves!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: The moment has finally come: a Phanpy has hatched from Ash's Pokémon Egg! The little Pokémon is full of energy and soon charging off...with our heroes and Team Rocket in tow!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Jessie, James, and Meowth take time to lick their wounds and dream of stealing Pikachu for the glory of Team Rocket. After a chance meeting with a Team Rocket scout, it seems these dreams are blasting off before their eyes!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: When thick fog interrupts our heroes' journey, a girl and her Ninetales invite them to rest at a nearby mansion...where Brock and their host fall into a romance that could turn out to be ghostly!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Near Mt. Mortar, our heroes run into a Trainer who is trying to curb a Tyrogue's wild ways. But when Team Rocket gets involved, will they be able to save the troublesome Tyrogue from the villains' clutches?

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Our heroes meet a young girl watching over a group of Xatu, whose psychic powers let them predict the future of a local village. When the villagers begin doubting their warnings, can the Xatu prove the truth of their visions?

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Reaching the Lake of Rage, Pikachu and Togepi begin to feel sick, and our heroes are attacked by an enraged red Gyarados. When Team Rocket appears on the scene, things look a lot more dangerous for Ash and friends…

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Things look bad for our heroes, who have been captured by Team Rocket at the Lake of Rage. With the fate of the world's Pokémon at stake, can Ash rise to the occasion and save the day?

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Finally reaching Mahogany Town, Ash is warming up for his next Gym battle. But after getting the cold shoulder from Gym Leader Pryce, can our hero convince his frosty opponent to give him a chance?

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Pryce and Ash are about to clash in a cold contest in the Mahogany Town Gym. Will Ash be able to show what he and his Pokémon are made of and earn his seventh Johto region Gym badge?

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Our heroes encounter battling groups of Bellossom and Vileplume, who have only recently evolved. As each group fights with increasing number and intensity, can our heroes put an end to the quarrelling?

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: The heat is rising in our heroes' journey when Misty and her Water-type Pokémon go head to head with a willful Fire-type Trainer!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Ash and the gang bump into a Pokémon magician, and soon they're on the hunt to find components for her greatest spell yet!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: After yet another close encounter with Team Rocket, Pikachu is left exhausted and weak. Thankfully, a passerby takes our heroes to a nearby lake that helps recharge Electric types…but also hides a great secret!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Our heroes take time out to enjoy the entertainment of a young Trainer and her Igglybuff variety act. But it's not long before Team Rocket arrives and tries to steal the show!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: A chance trip to a SlowPoké temple gives our heroes an opportunity to seek enlightenment…and gives Team Rocket the chance to lighten some pockets!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.sub-title: Will The Real Oak Please Stand Up?
programme.desc: A lavish celebrity event inspires Jessie and James to pretend to be the VIPs and fill their rumbling tummies. But it's not long before their disguises are put to the test by the real guest of honor: Professor Oak!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: When our heroes spot an object falling from the night sky, they rush to investigate. Soon, they find themselves joining forces with a Pokémon mystery club to uncover the secrets shared by the fallen Cleffa and the stars above!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Ash and Misty get into an argument over who can take on a powerful Trainer and his Poliwrath. When he accepts both challenges, the tough battles that follow give Misty some ideas for her own Poliwhirl!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Hearing of a nearby amusement park for battling, Ash is eager to test his skills. But the Team Rocket trio have recently joined the park, and they have a few ideas in store to test this Trainer's mettle!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: It's a case of mistaken identity for Misty's Politoed when it gets roped into replacing the leader of a Pokémon Cheer team...but where has the other Politoed gone?

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: On the outskirts of Blackthorn City, Ash meets Gym Leader Clair, who is busy training her Dratini for a ceremony. But Team Rocket has other plans for the Dragon-type Pokémon, and Ash and Clair must work together to stop them!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Facing off against Blackthorn Gym Leader Clair, Ash is finding it difficult to overcome the power of her Dragon-type Pokémon. Things are harder still when Team Rocket shows up to steal Blackthorn City's prized Dragon Fang relic!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Team Rocket has taken the Blackthorn City Dragon Fang and holed up deep within the Dragon's Den. Things look bad for the ancient relic, but help comes in the form of an old friend!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Ash and Clair finally face off in a Gym battle that will push Ash's skills as a Trainer to the limit! Can he win his final Johto Gym badge?

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: A Team Rocket trick takes all of Ash's hard-earned Johto Gym badges from him, but it's not long before the troublesome trio get a taste of their own medicine. What tricksy Pokémon could have beaten them at their own game?

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Discovering a nearby Pokémon synchronized swim team, Misty goes to check it out, and soon finds herself heading below the surface to take on the team's Trainer in an exciting underwater battle!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Ash barely makes it back to New Bark Town before he is off again, retrieving a Pokémon Egg for Professor Elm. However, things get interesting when he meets an old friend and Team Rocket shows up with more mischief!

programme.title: Pokémon: Master Quest
programme.desc: Professor Elm's Pokémon Egg hatches into a Larvitar! The Pokémon is unresponsive even after being checked over at the Pokémon Center, and Ash tries to cheer it up, but soon Team Rocket arrives to ruin all his hard work.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: On a seemingly routine spacewalk, disaster strikes, leaving two astronauts completely alone. As the deafening silence tells them they have lost any link to Earth, the only way home may be to go further into the terrifying expanse of space.

programme.title: The Mummy (1999)
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz star in this nonstop action epic about the discovery of a long-lost treasure in the Egyptian desert that also unearths a 3,000-year-old legacy of terror!

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser and an all-star cast reunite in this action-packed adventure where an accursed mummy is resurrected – along with a force even more powerful: The Scorpion King (The Rock).

programme.title: Hellboy (2004)
programme.desc: Born in the flames of hell and brought to Earth, Hellboy was rescued from sinister forces by the benevolent Dr. Broom, who raised him to be a hero. Hellboy stands as the key line of defense against an evil madman who seeks to destroy mankind.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

programme.title: Source Code
programme.desc: Jake Gyllenhaal stars in this action thriller about a man who awakens in another man’s body to discover only he has the ability to stop a terrorist attack on a commuter train.

programme.title: Ex Machina
programme.desc: A young programmer (Domhnall Gleeson) at an internet company is chosen by a reclusive CEO (Oscar Isaac) to evaluate the capabilities and consciousness of a beautiful and sophisticated robot (Alicia Vikander).

programme.title: Robocop
programme.desc: Detroit in the near future. A cop who dies in the line of duty is transformed into a crime-fighting cyborg by the corporation which now runs the police department. The only hitch: this "perfect" cop still seeks revenge on the creeps who mutilated him.

programme.title: Storage Wars: Northern Treasures
programme.desc: Ursula 'bro's out' at an auction in Ajax where she runs into buyers Mike and Armando. Bogart wears an eye-patch to cover an injury. Rick and Cindy do some basic training. Mike and Armando go for a spin with ice racing champion Anthony Barlow.

programme.title: Storage Wars: Northern Treasures
programme.desc: Cindy comes to an auction in Toronto with voodoo dolls of the other buyers. Rick's not convinced but knows better than to question Cindy.

programme.title: Storage Wars: Northern Treasures
programme.desc: Bogart sets out to make an “extreme locker buying” video at an auction in North Toronto with cameras on his and Paul's heads. Ursula looks even more glamorous, Rick and Cindy get their groom on, and Roy scores a date with Olympian Elizabeth Manley.

programme.title: Storage Wars: Northern Treasures
programme.sub-title: All's Well That Ends Wildly Ridiculous
programme.desc: Roy hires impersonators of the buyers at an auction. Paul and Bogart bond as they evade them. Rick and Cindy keep searching lockers and former NHL player Jim Thomson helps them find The Great One. Roy and Ursula's friendship blooms.

programme.title: Storage Wars: Northern Treasures
programme.desc: For the professional bidders, Aurora is a symphony of minor letdowns and major scores.

programme.title: Storage Wars: Northern Treasures
programme.desc: In Orangeville Rick and Cindy rock it, Paul and Bogart blow it, and Ursula goes bid crazy.

programme.title: Storage Wars: Northern Treasures
programme.desc: Brampton is a series of twists and turnarounds, where every locker contains a surprise package containing more - and less – than meets the eye.

programme.title: Storage Wars: Northern Treasures
programme.desc: It’s round robin mind-games when Ursula outsmarts Roy…who outsmarts Cindy…who outsmarts Paul and Bogart, who not so smartly make a bad decision.

programme.title: Storage Wars: Northern Treasures
programme.desc: North York becomes an archaeological dig as buyers unearth pieces of the past that could enrich their future.

programme.title: Storage Wars: Northern Treasures
programme.sub-title: Ain't No Locker Like a Birthday Locker
programme.desc: The competition is fierce on Rick’s birthday, a heated battle that sees several buyers finding items custom made to relieve the stress.

programme.title: The Liquidator
programme.desc: When Jeff finds negotiating with a couple of professional pickers too easy, his warning system begins to go off. Will Jeff figure out the catch in time, or will he fall headfirst into their trap?

programme.title: The Liquidator
programme.desc: On his way home from Alberta, Jeff struggles to flip a deal for antique tools. Will he get clobbered by cowboys, or knocked out by a girl in a teddy bear costume?

programme.title: The Liquidator
programme.desc: When Jeff tries to make a deal at his vet's office, his business goes to the dogs. Will he fare any better by letting José take the reins on the next one, or will his best frenemy sabotage him?

programme.title: The Liquidator
programme.desc: Jeff is left high and dry in California when he tries to help his friends stage a huge estate sale there. Will he pull off a desert miracle, or watch his profits disappear like a mirage?

programme.title: The Liquidator
programme.desc: Jeff's all tied up in knots when a chance house call to a Palm Springs collector leads him into a dungeon full of leather bondage gear.

programme.title: The Liquidator
programme.desc: Jeff gets saddled with a container full of unfashionable socks that no one in town will touch, until he decides that honesty isn’t the most profitable policy.

programme.title: Undercover Boss
programme.desc: The Boss of Twin Peaks goes undercover in his restaurant chain famous for scantily clad wait staff. An employee's crude language with customers throws the boss off guard. Former Hooters CEO Coby Brooks returns to the show with a darker side.

programme.title: Undercover Boss
programme.desc: In a series first, an openly gay boss goes undercover! Can the boss measure up while manning the floor in the lingerie department? The Boss is hot under the collar when an employee continues to bad mouth his company.

programme.title: Undercover Boss
programme.desc: Jane Grote Abell, Owner of Donato's Pizza, goes undercover to get an inside slice of the family business. The boss learns that the pizzas aren't the only things getting baked at one store. One store's archaic computer system leaves the boss in a bad mood.

programme.title: Undercover Boss
programme.desc: Anthony Wedo, CEO of Buffets Inc., travels from his corner office to the back of the house. The boss breaks cover when flooded with a dishwasher's nasty attitude. The high-energy Boss meets his match when faced with an unruly cash register.

programme.title: Wahlburgers
programme.desc: When Paul takes the day off work to play a round of golf with Mark, he leaves their mother, Alma, in charge of the day shift at their second restaurant "Alma Nove" -- much to her delight.

programme.title: Wahlburgers
programme.desc: Mark solicits his cousin, Johnny Drama, and friend, Billy Leonard, to take Paul out for a weekend of physical activity when he sees that Paul is putting on a few extra pounds.

programme.title: Wahlburgers
programme.desc: Alma Wahlberg's recipes have always been the talk of her family. Alma finally attempts to gather all of her kids' favorite recipes and share them with the public.Mark is up to his old childhood tricks when he hooks up with old buddy.

programme.title: Wahlburgers
programme.desc: Donnie and Mark decide to play a practical joke on big brother Paul by telling him that they want to create a Wahlburgers jingle.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men

programme.title: Two and a Half Men
programme.desc: Charlie ist scharf auf seine attraktive Nachbarin. Mit seinem Bruder Alan plant er ein Date mit der Angebeteten und deren Schwester. Doch statt in den Armen der Damen landen die zwei Casanovas verschnupft „Im Bett mit Angina“. Drollige „Männerwirtschaft“-Variante.

programme.title: La Porta Magica
programme.desc: Grazie ad Andrea Delogu e al suo team di coach specializzati in cambiamenti, persone comuni hanno la possibilità di realizzare il sogno di rivoluzionare la propria vita e mostrare la trasformazione ai propri cari.

programme.title: Blue Bloods
programme.desc: Frank et la présidente du conseil municipal Regina Thomas s'opposent au sujet des récentes manifestations contre les brutalités policières. Il rédige une lettre de démission pour le maire. Danny et Baez collaborent avec Jamie pour faire condamner un célèbre baron de la drogue après l'assassinat d'un témoin. Les liens de Joe Hill avec la famille Reagan sont révélés, ce qui provoque des tensions ave

programme.title: Report

programme.title: TG3 Mondo

programme.title: Fuori orario. Cose (mai) viste
programme.desc: Da oltre 10 anni Fuori Orario ci accompagna nell'avventura cinematografica italiana e straniera presentando non solo i film stessi ma facendoci conoscere anche gli autori.

programme.title: Route One/Usa
programme.desc: L'acteur et scénariste américain Robert Kramer retourne aux Etats-Unis après 10 ans d'absence, accompagné d'un comédien dans le rôle d'un médecin. Ensemble, ils parcourent la route numéro 1 de la frontière canadienne à Key West et dressent un tableau de l'Amérique.

programme.title: Fuori orario. Cose (mai) viste

programme.title: Agorà

A musei e luoghi di cultura, di conseguenza, la richiesta è quella di essere elementi vivi e vitali delle città, ponti di connessione e trasmissione, ma anche di creazione e formazione del sape

A sa mort, le compte Palladini lègue l'appartement le plus prestigieux, appelé "La terrazza" en raison de sa vue imprenable, à sa dernière fille naturelle, Anna Boschi, qu'il a eue avec la gouvernante.

programme.desc: I capolavori artistici di Roma tra il Quattrocento e il Seicento e la storia della città eterna e dei suoi grandi papi umanisti Eugenio IV, Pio II e Sisto IV e di quelli dei secoli successivi. programme.title: ReSearch
programme.desc: In questa puntata di Research, rubrica dedicata al mondo della ricerca storica, come e quanto il corpo degli italiani è in grado di "parlare" di sé, diventando esso stesso fonte storica non documentaria in senso tradizionale, ma comunque di primissima mano. Ospite in studio la Professoressa Margherita Platania, docente di storia contemporanea all'università di Salerno.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby

Nachdem Sisko erfährt, dass nicht nur Bajor, sondern auch die Romulaner einen Nichtangriffspakt mit dem Dominion geschlossen haben, muss der Captain handeln. programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine

programme.title: S3E14 - Anger management
programme.desc: Ish-lojtari i bejsbollit Charlie është një terapist i menaxhimit të zemërimit me grupe të vogla në shtëpi. Ai ka një vajzë adoleshente OCD, një ish-grua dhe një mik/terapist seksi.

programme.title: Kthim në Shkollë
programme.desc: S’ka qene kurre nje vajze e hedhur. S’e ka ndjekur kurre moden dhe s’eshte konsideruar seksi. Tani eshte nje gazetare 25 vjeçare dhe i duhet te hiqet si nje adoleshente per t’i krijuar vetes nje mundesi te dyte per nje reputacion te ri.

programme.title: Gjëja më e ëmbël
programme.desc: C.Diaz, C.Applegate. Kristina Uolltersi ishte betuar se s’do të linte më asnjë mashkull t’i afrohej. Por pikërisht kur hoqi dorë nga dashuria, dashuria e gjeti atë. Por kësaj radhe rruga për tek mashkulli ideal është plot me surpriza.

programme.title: Familja Miçell kundra makinerive
programme.desc: Një apokalips robotik ndërpret udhëtimin e familjes Mitçell rreth e qark vendit. Tani, familja më e rrëmujshme dhe e pazakontë në botë, duhet të shpëtojë njerëzimin.

programme.title: Ishulli i Nimit
programme.desc: Jodie Foster, Gerard Butler, Abigail Breslin. Vogëlushja Nim jeton me të atin në një ishull të largët të Paqësorit. Kur babai I saj zhduket papritur, Nimi i kërkon ndihmë autores së romaneve të saj. Por shkrimtarja është në të vërtetë një njeri i pasigurtë që s’ka dalë kurrë nga shtëpia.

programme.title: Një letër për ty
programme.desc: Tom Hanks dhe Meg Rajan do të jenë protagonistë të një njohjeje të çuditshme. Armiq në botën reale, por dy shpirtra binjakë në atë virtuale. Të dy janë në biznesin e librit, por ai është i dhënë pas parasë, kurse ajo tepër sentimentale.

programme.title: Getsbi i madh
programme.desc: Me regji të Baz Luhrmann vjen përshtatja në ekran e romanit të konsideruar si kryevepra e shkrimtarit amerikan F. Scott Fitzgerald. Vitet 20, ndryshimet sociale dhe dekadenca morale në një histori tragjike dashurie.

programme.title: Eyes wide shut
programme.desc: Filmi i fundit i S.Kubrick. Fantazitë më të pabesueshme bëhen realitet për një bashkëshort që mendonte se kishte gjithçka në jetën e tij. Xhelozia, tradhëtia e mendjes dhe ajo e trupit, përzihen me misterin dhe krimin.

programme.title: Vingt-quatre préludes et fugues de Chostakovitch
Ludwig Wicki, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, DR Junior Choir & Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt. Highlights include ‘He's a pirate/Davy Jones' from Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest ‘Now We Are Free' from Gladiator ‘My Heart Will Go On' from Titanic and ‘Shallow' from A Star Is Born. Featured soloists in this concert are the young talented singers Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger and Diluckshan Jeyaratnam. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2022.

programme.title: Silas Bjerregard, Clara Cecilie Thomsen, eee gee & Caspar Phillipson
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir take you on a musical journey through the greatest Oscar-winning films, from timeless classics like Casablanca to monumental masterpieces like The Godfather and iconic blockbusters like Forrest Gump —epic movies with music that deserves its very own place in film history. These are famous soundtracks that, for nearly a century, have made us shiver, melt, and cry in the darkness of the cinema. Christian Schumann conducts The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir and soloists are Silas Bjerregaard and eee gee with host Caspar Phillipson as special guest.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Klaus Tönshoff, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & DR Big Band
programme.desc: Musicians of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, the DR Big Band, and the Danish National Vocal Ensemble join forces under the baton of Klaus Tönshoff in this dazzling concert featuring great songs from black and white cinema. Norwegian mezzosoprano Tuva Semmingsen sings ‘Diamonds Are A Girl's Best Friend', from Gentlemen Prefer Blondes, ‘My Favorite Things' from The Sound of Music, ‘Over the Rainbow' from The Wizard of Oz, ‘Moon River' from Breakfast at Tiffany's, and many other unforgettable hits. This concert performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2020.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt & Gewandhausorchester Leipzig
programme.sub-title: Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig's Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek's Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek's only symphony – was never performed during the composer's lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today. Also on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Symphony No. 38 in D major, K. 504. This work, which premiered while Mozart was visiting Prague in 1787, is often referred to as the ‘Prague Symphony'.

programme.title: Marta Gardolińska, Gareth Davies & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: The LSO performs Boulanger, Dalbavie & Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Polish conductor Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Lili Boulanger's D'un Martin de Printemps, Marc-André Dalbavie's Concerto for Flute, and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The luminous optimism of the young Boulanger is poles apart from the raw passion and white-hot melodies of Tchaikovsky's semi-autobiographical symphony. LSO principal flute Gareth Davies brings out all the dazzle and daring of Dalbavie's 21st-century classic. The program closes with Prayer for Ukraine by composer Valentin Silvestrov. This concert was recorded at LSO St Luke's in London, UK, on May 18, 2022.

La violence du crime, la mise en examen de trois suspects très différents et la notoriété du suspect numéro 1 disparu, tout a concouru pour faire de cet homicide un cas hors du commun.

programme.title: Non élucidé

Après plusieurs investigations, un homme finit par avouer le meurtre avant de se rétracter. L'enquête se poursuit pendant des années.

programme.title: Non élucidé

Les investigations réalisées pour la retrouver ne donne rien. Et si la vérité était à chercher du côté de son petit ami ?

programme.title: Non élucidé

programme.title: Non élucidé

programme.title: Khabar Dari Casablanca
programme.desc: Kisah kehidupan sepasang suami isteri romantis yang bekerja di luar negara. Akibat satu insiden, suaminya hilang dan tidak dapat dikesan dan ramai percaya bahawa dia telah meninggal dunia. Isterinya tidak dapat menerima berita tersebut sebaliknya yakin yang suaminya masih hidup. Dia terus menghantar emel kepada suaminya sehingga dituduh tidak siuman dan dimasukkan ke hospital sakit jiwa.

Mais un meurtre met brutalement fin aux festivités. Un homme a été assassiné dans la célèbre abbaye, qui sert d'enceinte à l'école. programme.desc: Territoire méconnu aux confins de l'Arctique, à mi-chemin entre l'Europe continentale et le pôle Nord, le Svalbard, 60 000 kilomètres carrés, est devenu l'un des laboratoires scientifiques du changement climatique; mais l'archipel norvégien revêt aussi un fort intérêt géostratégique, car il pourrait servir d'alibi à la Russie pour attaquer le pays.

programme.title: Climat d'urgence

programme.title: Express
programme.desc: ”Express” është emisioni televiziv me historinë më të gjatë në transmetim ndër televizionet kosovare. Në sezonin e shtatëmbëdhjetë vazhdon të jetë emisioni i pasdites për kosovarët. Magazina e pasdites në KTV është adresë për tema nga fusha të ndryshme, që nga zhvillimet politike e sociale, e deri te lajmet nga kultura, showbizi dhe sporti.

programme.title: Lajmet e mbrëmjes
programme.desc: Lajmet e Mbrëmjes, çdo mbrëmje nga ora 19:00, janë edicioni kryesor dhe më i besueshëm i lajmeve në Kosovë. Një grup gazetarësh e redaktorësh sjellin të gjitha lajmet nga politika deri te kultura, nga secili skaj i Kosovës. Në edicionin qendror të lajmeve ndër vite janë ekspozuar skandalet më të mëdha, keqpërdorimet enorme, gëzimet, festat, por edhe fatkeqësitë e popullit të Kosovës.

programme.desc: At the end of March 1945, with the German Army depleted and Hitler's circle of trust rapidly shrinking, Hitler invites a group of Hitler Youth to the Reich Chancellery gardens to be congratulated.

programme.title: Main Street Ontario
programme.desc: Each Saturday night during the summer, residents in Kincardine gather downtown for a parade, led by the town's Scottish pipe band.

programme.title: Digging for Britain
programme.desc: The south of England offers rich pickings, including the earliest money made in Britain and a massive haul of Roman treasure that brings to life the fall of the empire in Britain.

programme.title: First Wars
programme.desc: The modern-day city of Sydney was the birthplace of contemporary Australia; with no treaty in place, the relationship between the European occupying forces and the land's First Nations people was predetermined to be violent.

programme.title: Hope for Wildlife
programme.desc: A muskrat trapped in a fence needs Hope's help and slippery patients give the team a tough time.

programme.title: Ontario Hubs
programme.desc: Former track athlete turned model Rachel Romu hopes to change the fashion industry by bringing visibility to those with disabilities.

programme.title: The Rundown
programme.desc: Ontario is making changes to OSAP, reshaping how students access financial support for post-secondary education. What will the changes mean for students and the cost of going to school? Then, Ontario's teachers are heading back to the bargaining table. What are educators asking for, and could negotiations affect classrooms across the province?

programme.title: Book Hungry Bears
programme.desc: Four bears named Crystal, Boomer Melody and Scout explore their paper craft world in search of a good book to read.

programme.title: 16 Hudson
programme.desc: Sam is thrilled that Ivan is coming back to 16 Hudson as a tenant but feels left behind when Ivan shows up with his new wife, Suzi.

programme.title: Audrey's Shelter
programme.desc: Marcelo, a young golden lion tamarin has the opportunity to leave the shelter and return to the wild; Audrey is not ready to let him go.

programme.title: Animanimals
programme.desc: The rhino is looking forward to his date with the rhino lady.

programme.title: Odo
programme.desc: Odo and Doodle, in sun and moon costumes, struggle to deliver their eclipse rhyme as the sky darkens; campers panic, blaming themselves for the eclipse; Odo gives them a task: chickens crow, Leonardo sucks in air, Thelma makes noise and the sun returns.

programme.title: Tiny and Tall
programme.desc: Tall plans a special picnic party for his buddies; Tiny gets so excited, she forgets how to share; Tiny's friends help her ensure that everything's fair and square.

programme.title: Xavier Riddle and the Secret Museum
programme.desc: Watching Julia Child follow a step-by-step recipe encourages Xavier to do the same to build a model airplane.

programme.title: Wacky Media Songs
programme.desc: Ava falls for an April Fool's joke her friend plays on her, and realizes she should check where information comes from before believing it; Ava plays detective as she sings about checking sources, so others won't get fooled like she did.

programme.title: Polly Can Do
programme.desc: Polly and her friends are having a Dance Competition at the Forest Fort, using the ramp as a catwalk for strutting their fancy dance moves to music. But with Boo determined to join in, things don't go as planned until Polly finds a way of making the game less competitive and more inclusive of her playful pup.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: When Boomer challenges Roxi to a race to the top of a mountain, his reckless driving causes an avalanche of boulders.

programme.title: TVOkids Hosted Breaks
programme.desc: Do you know what this word means?

programme.title: Odd Squad
programme.desc: Omni and Osric are desperate to get off the night shift and go to a party, but they must first stop a mysterious villain; Orwell and Okra must prevent a flying machine from stinking up Odd Squad's favorite places.

programme.title: Hungry Brain
programme.desc: The top five facts on the Indian Ocean; five its name comes from a country, four it's the baby of the Oceans, three it is medium-sized two The Suez Canal and one it is influenced by the winds.

programme.title: The Screen Team
programme.desc: After their phones suddenly stop working, Reid and Leia go to a repair shop to learn how devices are fixed. They explore common tech problems, tiny internal parts and why the right to repair means you don't always need a new phone.

programme.title: ABC With Kenny G
programme.desc: Kenny G sings about the letter W to a crowd of animals, taking them for a walk in a world full of wallabies, windy woods and watermelons.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: The adventures of friends who can always count on each other.

programme.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programme.desc: A living vine wraps itself around the feet of Ginger and Kid Broce, binding them together; after some trial and error, the pair get used to moving as one, so much so that they don't want to become untangled!

programme.title: Interstellar Ella
programme.desc: Priya arrives to complete a school project about Mars; Ella, Slippy and Madhu convince Priya that she needs to try new things to experience Mars.

programme.title: The Game Catchers
programme.desc: The Game Catchers visit a planet where they get to play in a life-size pinball machine; when the ball they need gets lost in the machine, they must track it down.

programme.title: Messy Goes to OKIDO
programme.desc: Messy joins his friends in Okido on an adventure; they explore the electrical world of circuits to fix Zoe's communicator.

programme.title: Animanimals
programme.desc: In an ocean full of fish, the puffer fish is trying to seem as big and strong as possible.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: The Goodways drift out to sea on a swan-shaped float and need rescue from a flock of real swans aiming to protect the giant inflatable; Mayor Humdinger steals Katie's Portable Pet Wash and ends up causing bubble trouble all over town.

programme.title: TVOkids Hosted Breaks
programme.desc: Join Gabrielle for a challenge!

programme.title: Rosie's Rules
programme.desc: Rosie and Javi's pirate adventure goes awry; Rosie has trouble choosing a job at the first Fun Club meeting.

programme.title: Create
programme.desc: An educational program that shares fun arts and crafts ideas that can be tried out at home; from food art, to hairstyles, to origami and paper planes.

programme.title: Donkey Hodie
programme.desc: Duck's magic trick goes awry, turning her neighbors' things into pickles; Donkey is afraid to scooter after a fall.

programme.title: Woolly Woolly
programme.desc: Marco envies Lila's marbles; Bibi trades his gift flower for shinier ones.

programme.title: BooSnoo!
programme.desc: A unique blend of calm and exploration provides the chance to reset as a red ball embarks on a fantastical adventure filled with art and creativity.

programme.title: Momolu and Friends
programme.desc: Momolu, Banni, Hiko, DJ Bass, and Nooni work on Huhu's new play; confusion ensues causing the friends to refocus on what they are good at, which is having lots and lots of fun.

programme.title: Kid-E-Cats
programme.desc: Kitties Cookie, Pudding and Candy learn to look before they leap with their boundless imagination.

programme.title: Gabby's Farm
programme.desc: Gabby sees how the tomatoes grow at Farmer Shauna's; she counts to seven as she helps to harvest the ones that are ready for picking.

programme.title: Pip and Posy
programme.desc: Pip and Posy try to stay up late for a midnight snack.

programme.title: Bamboo Loves Music
programme.desc: Playing to an audience of toys, Bamboo Love imagines becoming a rock-and-roll guitar star; but when the only sounds expelled are from plastic buttons on a toy guitar, Bamboo Love searches for the real thing but is surprised to find various types of guitars; unsure which to use, she tries them all out and picks the one that electrifies her spirit.

programme.title: Mia & Codie
programme.desc: Codie wants to play the music for Velvet's show, only he doesn't have enough space in his block dock for an entire melody; when Mia presents him with a macro block, Codie becomes a music bot, playing a melody that gets everyone dancing.

programme.title: Ladybird and Bee
programme.desc: Ladybird and Bee discover that the daisies curl up and go to sleep at nighttime too.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: The Terrible Twos show up and decide to tickle their friends.

programme.title: The Treebees
programme.desc: The Treebees' unique take on the classic nursery rhyme, Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, sung in the lullaby version inspired by the original poem by Jane Taylor.

programme.title: Polkaroo Counts!
programme.desc: Polkaroo and Malik are getting ready to meet all of their friends, but they have to make sure they bring the right number of snacks for each friend before leaving; they use a graph to organize and collect the information of all the snacks they need.

programme.title: The Game Catchers
programme.desc: The Game Catchers land on a planet covered in rivers and lakes that are made of fruit juice; they learn the game Hoop Game, but things get complicated after Boxy loses control of his hoop and sends them on a mission to help a local Applephant. programme.title: Canada Crew
programme.desc: Bebe and Mo get stuck inside the lodge because of the rain, and they learn about the seasons from a climatologist; Gavin gets lost in the Grand Banks.

programme.title: Dr. Cheddar
programme.desc: Annie and Felix decide to put on one of their favorite plays, but they both want to play the role of the cow.

programme.title: Happy Place
programme.desc: Harry smells - he needs a bath! He learns the importance of good hygiene and how it affects his friendships.

programme.title: Gabby's Farm
programme.desc: Gabby counts to two at a farm with turkeys, ducks and cute baby chicks.

programme.title: B.O.T. and The Beasties
programme.desc: The Flying Sticky zips around amongst the trees of Jungly, Splashy World, squirting out multicolored sticky streamers; B.O.T. keeps getting covered in the sticky ribbons, which makes this mission quite tricky.

programme.title: Hungry Brain
programme.desc: The top three facts on scuba diving; everyone back to school; keep calm and scuba on; depth intoxication.

programme.title: Burps, Butts and Bones
programme.desc: A medical skeleton named Bones answers body-related questions that are sent in by real-life children, while a squad of kid reporters known as the B Team find out more about the topic.

programme.title: Galapagos X
programme.desc: In the future, confused birds are crashing everyone's parties.

programme.title: Wacky Number Songs
programme.desc: Ava builds the best fort ever.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: The PAW Patrol works to free a bat family after a rock slide traps them inside their cave; snowboarders on Jake's Mountain become stuck on a broken chairlift while a monster is on the loose.

programme.title: TVOkids Hosted Breaks
programme.desc: How Long Do Sharks Live?

programme.title: Wordsville
programme.desc: Baker Graham's celebration cake is gone and there's nothing to celebrate in Wordsville until it's found; firefighter Ember and Artist Clay are the suspects; thanks to Gabby and Sly the word celebration soon returns to Wordsville.

programme.title: Animanimals
programme.desc: The hammerhead shark wants to dance at the shark party, but his dancing is hammer hard and wild.

programme.title: Caillou
programme.desc: In music class, Caillou tries to impress Ms. Martin by blurting out all the answers to her questions; on a long road trip to the farm, Caillou can't help but get increasingly bored, so he pretends to be on a quest to find the cure for boredom.

Komisarz Alex
programme.desc: Snajper strzela do ludzi na bazarze. Ginie mężczyzna badający aferę finansową. Odsunięta od śledztwa Monika prowadzi własne dochodzenie, które łączy się z jej przeszłością.

programme.title: Nic śmiesznego
programme.desc: Adam Miauczyński to reżyser filmów porno. Został nim w nadziei zdobycia sławy i bogactwa. Ale mija już czterdziestka, a jego marzeniom wciąż daleko do realizacji. Długi czas był tylko drugim reżyserem, na dodatek stale wyrzucanym z pracy.

programme.title: Archiwista
programme.desc: Henrykowi nie daje spokoju sprawa śmierci Bożyńskiego. Jego podejrzenia wzbudza lekarz, który wystawił akt zgonu. Kilka lat wcześniej był oskarżany o spowodowanie śmierci pacjenta, ale ostatecznie syn ofiary wycofał zarzuty.

programme.title: Archiwista
programme.desc: Późnym wieczorem mężczyzna przychodzi do znajomego, do domku letniskowego na wódkę. Zostaje ogłuszony przez gospodarza i utopiony w misce z wodą. Nazajutrz na komendzie zjawia Zenon Kurtyba, który twierdzi, że był świadkiem zbrodni.

programme.title: Ojciec Mateusz
programme.desc: W okolicach kościoła Natalia znajduje martwego mężczyznę. Okazuje się, że zmarł z wycieńczenia. W mieście niedawno została zamknięta noclegownia. W parku znaleziono kolejnego martwego mężczyznę. Sekcja wskazuje na zatrucie alkaloidem. Trop prowadzi do kościoła. Okazuje się, że ktoś chciał otruć księdza Mateusza.

programme.title: My, ewangelicy warszawscy
programme.desc: Ich początki w stolicy sięgają czasów, gdy ewangelicy reformowani nie mogli swobodnie spotykać się. Dzisiaj ta warszawska wspólnota ma już dwieście pięćdziesiąt lat. Jej historia jest również historią troski o drugiego człowieka...

programme.title: Gwiazdorska kuchnia Ani
programme.desc: W tym odcinku gościem Anny Strażyńskiej jest Alessandro Parrello.

programme.title: Zaginione? Ocalone? Historie zawodów różnych
programme.desc: W tym odcinku cyklu Zaginione? Ocalone? Historie zawodów różnych - wizyta w warsztacie zecera.

programme.title: Blondynka
programme.desc: Na przystani w Majakach na kapitana czeka Jagna z rodziną. Kapitan ma przypłynąć stateczkiem, który będzie ich nowym domem. Sylwia towarzyszy przyjaciołom. Kapitan istotnie przypływa lecz nie statkiem turystycznym, ale łódeczką.

programme.title: Blondynka
programme.desc: Przez prześwietlone słońcem majakowe łąki idzie Auguścik, zbiera kwiaty. Bukiet przeznaczony jest dla Sylwii, która jeszcze tego samego dnia zostanie Kobietą Roku Podlasia.

programme.title: Zmiennicy
programme.desc: Znany reżyser Barewicz otrzymuje wiadomość, że na festiwalu filmowym w Berlinie Zachodnim przyznano mu Grand Prix i nagrodę rzeczową w postaci mercedesa. Natychmiast wyrusza na przejście graniczne po odbiór samochodu.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Bruno udaje przed dziewczyną, że jest piłkarzem, chociaż nie potrafi grać. Za to Zuza staje się cleanfluencerką, która nie potrafi sprzątać, a Maja wspomina przygody z mamą, w które nikt nie chce jej uwierzyć.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: W następstwie publikacji artykułu Weroniki, Borys występuje do pana Bogumiła z nową propozycją ugody, na którą mężczyzna przystaje. Rozmowa Huberta z Adamem przeradza się w otwarty konflikt, co budzi nieskrywaną satysfakcję Wilka i Lucyny.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Reportaże o niezwykłych miejscach w Polsce. W tym odcinku: dziennikarski Żoliborz.

programme.title: Wojenne dziewczyny
programme.desc: Major Powała przesłuchuje Kamila Brodzkiego. Nie wierzy, że porucznik cierpi na całkowitą amnezję. Do pokoju wchodzi niespodziewanie Irka, podbiega do Kamila, lecz on jej nie poznaje. Irka ma żal do brata, że ukrywał przed nią prawdę.

programme.title: Dom
programme.desc: W kamienicy na Złotej pojawia się pierwszy telewizor. Szczęśliwymi posiadaczami są Wrotkowie. Andrzej i Wiktor chcą postawić na cmentarzu w Sierpuchowie pomnik upamiętniający walkę i śmierć ich przyjaciół z AK.

programme.title: Muzyczne naj
programme.desc: W tym odcinku pojawiają się utwory, muzyka i historia dokonań scenicznych Edyty Geppert.

programme.title: Komisarz Alex
programme.desc: Snajper strzela do ludzi na bazarze. Ginie mężczyzna badający aferę finansową. Odsunięta od śledztwa Monika prowadzi własne dochodzenie, które łączy się z jej przeszłością.

programme.title: Nic śmiesznego
programme.desc: Adam Miauczyński to reżyser filmów porno. Został nim w nadziei zdobycia sławy i bogactwa. Ale mija już czterdziestka, a jego marzeniom wciąż daleko do realizacji. Długi czas był tylko drugim reżyserem, na dodatek stale wyrzucanym z pracy.

programme.title: W światłach zorzy
programme.desc: Na dalekiej północy, w Laponii, czas płynie inaczej. Surowe warunki, które zmuszają mieszkańców do korzystania z psich zaprzęgów, wydają się Monice i Maćkowi spełnieniem ich marzeń. Film przedstawia kilka dni z życia polskiej rodziny, która w 2017 roku zdecydowała się zamieszkać w jednym z najzimniejszych miejsc na Ziemi.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: W następstwie publikacji artykułu Weroniki, Borys występuje do pana Bogumiła z nową propozycją ugody, na którą mężczyzna przystaje. Rozmowa Huberta z Adamem przeradza się w otwarty konflikt, co budzi nieskrywaną satysfakcję Wilka i Lucyny.

programme.title: Rączka gotuje
programme.desc: Remigiusz Rączka kontynuuje jesienną rajzę po Śląsku, żeby sprawdzić, jak zmienia się nasz region. Tym razem odwiedza teren po byłej kopalni Rozbark w Bytomiu. W Izbie Tradycji gotuje wspólnie z młodzieżą - uczestnikami konkursu "TransformujeMY Śląskie. Młodzi dla młodych", a w menu kapuśniak na gęsinie i torcik cwibakowy.

programme.title: Na tropach historii
programme.desc: Cykl przybliżający historię województwa świętokrzyskiego. Opisując zrywy narodowe, klęski, wielkie i małe zwycięstwa, najnowsze odkrycia archeologiczne i geologiczne. Podążamy śladami, które pozostawiła historia.

programme.title: Ranczo
programme.desc: Kontynuacja popularnego serialu komediowego o tematyce obyczajowej. Serial opowiada o perypetiach młodej Amerykanki, która na skutek splotu różnych okoliczności życiowych osiedla się w małej, podlaskiej wsi Wilkowyje.

programme.title: Polacy światu
programme.desc: Aleksander Brückner wybitny slawista, badacz języka i kultury polskiej urodził się 29 stycznia 1856 roku w Tarnopolu. Kształcił się w Lipsku, Berlinie i Wiedniu. W wieku 25 lat rozpoczął współpracę z katedrą języków i literatur słowiańskich.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Patrycja odkrywa, że jej postać w serialu zostanie uśmiercona, a Zuza organizuje internetową kampanię ratunkową. Sylwester unika rozmowy z Mają o stracie mamy, ale w końcu musi się z tym zmierzyć. Patrycja dostaje rolę życia. Czy wyprowadzi się i zniknie z rodziny Dzików?

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia

programme.desc: 《Rebel Artist》是一部聚焦於亞洲與全球具突破性視野的藝術創作者的紀錄片系列。每一集以一位（或一組）藝術家為主角，深入他們的創作背景、人生故事，以及他們如何用藝術回應社會、文化、性別、歷史等議題。

programme.desc: 紀實節目《Top of the Wave》，正是從這片浪潮中誕生。節目以台灣為起點，跟隨一群台灣衝浪選手，從國內的訓練日常出發，踏上與世界較量的旅程。陳懷本來自不靠海的南投，卻把大海當成生命的方向，在一次次的浪頭與落敗之間，重新定義自己；詹博宇成長於美國聖地牙哥，在太平洋兩岸的文化夾縫中長大，衝浪對他而言從不只是熟悉的運動，更是一條通往身分認同的路。

programme.title: Satoyama-Wild Neighbors:1
programme.desc: 《Satoyama: Wild Neighbors》一共三集，深入貢寮、南投與苗栗的淺山環境，透過石虎、食蟹?、穿山甲、台灣角金龜等明星物種的生命故事，記錄人與自然在農村、森林與水田間交織而成的生態網絡，也看見居民、研究者與保育團隊如何攜手守護土地，尋找人與自然共生的可能。

programme.title: Come Away With Me:12
programme.desc: 《三人成行》（Come Away with Me）則以自助旅行為主軸，藉由節目呈現了解外國人會如何安排台灣的旅程，也展現台灣自由又充滿包容性的社會風情

programme.title: Rebel Artist S2:4
programme.desc: 《Rebel Artist》是一部聚焦於亞洲與全球具突破性視野的藝術創作者的紀錄片系列。每一集以一位（或一組）藝術家為主角，深入他們的創作背景、人生故事，以及他們如何用藝術回應社會、文化、性別、歷史等議題。

programme.title: Zoom In, Zoom Out:318
programme.desc: 透過深入採訪、實地走訪與國際連線，帶領觀眾探索台灣的重要議題。由製作人王品軒（Isabel Wang）與麥亞歷（Alec MacDonald）策劃，以貼近生活、兼具國際視野的敘事方式，呈現值得被看見的台灣故事。

programme.title: Spirits of Taiwan:1

programme.title: Shipwrecks Taiwan:4
programme.desc: 全片探訪了八個台灣的沈船地點，它們曾經是縱橫海上的鋼鐵巨人，因為不同原因而長眠海底，現在成為了眾多海洋生物最溫暖的家。本節目由具備將近30年節目製作與豐富水下攝影經驗的李景白擔任導演，他所帶領的製作團隊包括配樂、剪輯也都是金獎等級的成員，並由藝人王陽明擔任旁白以及潛水引路者。

programme.title: Viva La Vita:4
programme.desc: 《我在工場拍拍手》節目，走訪全台16個工「場」，包括：飛機維修廠、遊艇製造廠、酪農場、螺絲廠、麵包廠、伐木場、米酒廠、玻璃工廠、家具工廠等等，彰顯產品製造的細節美學，以及職人們追求精進的態度，將生硬的產業題材提煉出溫柔的故事。

programme.title: Boys' Night Out

When Fred (Garner), the only bachelor in the group, rents an apartment for their dalliances, he meets gorgeous Cathy (Kim Novak), whom he hires to be their "housekeeper." Cathy lets them all make plays for her, but has no intention of sleeping with them -- she is merely doing research for her sociology thesis.

programme.title: Incendiary Blonde
programme.desc: In 1909, lively Texas Guinan (Betty Hutton) attends a Wild West show and, dressing like a man, enters a bucking bronco contest and wins. Impressed by her audacity, the show's manager, Bill (Arturo de Córdova), hires her. In order to help support her family, Texas joins the rodeo and thrills the audience with her daredevil act. Texas and Bill soon fall in love, but Bill refuses to marry her, so Texas leaves the show for the bright lights of Broadway -- not realizing that Bill hides a secret.

programme.title: The Miracle of Morgan's Creek
programme.desc: In this wacky Preston Sturges comedy, the soldier-smitten Trudy Kockenlocker (Betty Hutton) discovers that she is both married and pregnant after a raucous troop send-off party. While she has no idea who her new husband is, her longtime admirer, Norval Jones (Eddie Bracken), seizes the opportunity to help. When Trudy's cop father (William Demarest) catches wind of the situation, however, wacky misunderstandings follow, with the well-meaning Norval on the wrong side of the law.

programme.desc: Drifter Sam Wild (Lawrence Tierney) murders a Reno, Nev., boardinghouse owner and her boyfriend in a fit of jealousy. Tenant Helen Brent (Claire Trevor) discovers the bodies, but instead of reporting the crime, she leaves for San Francisco as planned to return to her wealthy fiancé. On the same train, Sam flirts with Helen, then tracks her to her half-sister's house, where he continues to pursue her. Although Helen suspects Sam is a murderer, she inexplicably protects him from an investigator.

programme.title: D.O.A.

Determined to find out who his murderer is, Frank, with the help of his assistant and girlfriend, Paula (Pamela Britton), begins to trace back over his last steps. As he frantically tries to unravel the mystery behind his own impending demise, his sleuthing leads him to a group of crooked businessmen and another murder.

programme.title: Stormy Weather
programme.desc: Bill Williamson (Bill Robinson), a struggling performer, meets a beautiful vocalist named Selina Rogers (Lena Horne). Bill promises her that they will be together after he becomes a success. However, he and Selina both skyrocket to fame and lose contact. Fortunately, Bill just might get one more chance to woo Selina at a huge musical stage show. Popular entertainers of the 1940s, including Fats Waller and Cab Calloway, perform as themselves in the film.

programme.title: A Song Is Born
programme.desc: A group of music professors, including Frisbee (Danny Kaye) and Magenbruch (Benny Goodman), are writing an encyclopedia of music. A pair of window washers introduces the duo to a pioneering musical form called jazz. Frisbee and Magenbruch start going to nightclubs to hear the new sound and become involved with club singer Honey Swanson (Virginia Mayo), who is running from police because they want her to inform on her gangster boyfriend, Tony Crow (Steve Cochran).

programme.title: Reveille With Beverly
programme.desc: As the substitute host on a morning radio program, former switchboard operator Beverly Ross (Ann Miller) becomes a local sensation when she changes the format to hot boogie-woogie. Wanting to meet the mysterious disc jockey, millionaire Barry Lang (William Wright) switches identities with his chauffeur, Andy Adams (Dick Purcell), so Barry can woo her without revealing his wealth. When Beverly's new job is jeopardized, they team up with soldiers at a nearby military base to save her show.

programme.title: Hollywood Hotel
programme.desc: After losing a coveted role in an upcoming film to another actress, screen queen Mona Marshall (Lola Lane) protests by refusing to appear at her current movie's premiere. Her agent discovers struggling actress Virginia Stanton (Rosemary Lane) -- an exact match for Mona -- and sends her to the premiere instead, with young musician Ronnie Bowers (Dick Powell). After various mishaps, including a case of mistaken identity, Ronnie and Virginia struggle to find success in Hollywood.

programme.title: Ship Ahoy
programme.desc: Tallulah Winters (Eleanor Powell), a Broadway dancer, is inadvertently involved in a spy plot when she agrees to carry a vital piece of equipment on a cruise to Rio. The spy ringleader got the idea of using an entertainer from a story by eccentric dime magazine writer Merton K. Kibble (Red Skelton) -- whose friend Skip Owens (Bert Lahr) has convinced him to take the cruise as well. Tallulah and Merton hit it off, until Tallulah overhears him discussing a plot for a story and thinks he is a spy.

programme.title: Du Barry Was a Lady
programme.desc: In this adaptation of a Cole Porter Broadway musical, star singer May wants to marry a rich man, but her heart belongs to a penniless dancer named Alec. Louis Blore, who has just won a fortune through the sweepstakes, promptly marries May. However, after Louis accidentally has a laced drink, he has a fantastic dream in which he, May and Alec are members of the royal French court. Once Louis awakens, he begins to reconsider his relationship with May.

programme.title: The Old Man and the Sea
programme.desc: An old Cuban fisherman (Spencer Tracy) has not caught anything in 84 days. Despite the devotion of the young boy (Felipe Pazos) who brings him coffee and food, the fisherman fears he has become perpetually unlucky. On his 85th day of fishing, the old man catches a small fish and decides to keep fishing. When one of his multiple fishing lines hooks a large marlin, he decides to not return to shore until he reels in the fish. For two days and nights, the man sits alone, waiting to redeem himself.

programme.desc: When spoiled Harvey Cheyne (Freddie Bartholomew) is suspended from boarding school, his businessman father (Melvyn Douglas) takes him to Europe on a business trip. When the rebellious lad falls overboard from the steamship, he is saved from death by humble fisherman Manuel Fidello (Spencer Tracy) and forced by the captain of the fishing schooner (Lionel Barrymore) to become a low-ranking member of the ship's crew alongside the captain's own son (Mickey Rooney).

programme.title: Malaya
programme.desc: Soon after the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, cynical former newspaper correspondent John Royer (James Stewart) devises a scheme with his old editor and government agents to return to the Far East and smuggle out a vast amount of rubber for the war effort. Demanding the freedom and company of his ex-friend, Carnahan (Spencer Tracy), whom he betrayed in an exposé years earlier, Royer sails off into the hands of the Japanese with a motley crew, gold and the promise of covert government aid.

programme.title: Northwest Passage
programme.desc: An epic Western, about Major Robert Rogers, the tough frontiersman who led a grueling expedition to Canada in 1759 to punish a fearsome Indian tribe and seek a northwest passage to the Pacific. Langdon Towne and Hunk Marriner joined the Rangers at the Indian village, but when they head on to Fort Wentworth, they find the place deserted.

programme.title: Plymouth Adventure
programme.desc: Stubborn Capt. Christopher Jones (Spencer Tracy) pilots the historically famous Mayflower on its maiden voyage across the storm-swept Atlantic. Thankfully, a resourceful carpenter (Van Johnson) keeps the weather damage in check. Also among the passengers is Dorothy (Gene Tierney), the wife of the religiously zealous leader of the pilgrims. Jones finds himself drawn to Dorothy, despite her unattainable status. Soon a rivalry between his unsavory crew and the prim and proper pilgrims emerges.

programme.title: Executive Action
programme.desc: In 1963, with President John F. Kennedy growing more liberal and humanitarian in his policies, a shadowy cabal of Texas oil magnates, hardline conservatives, intelligence agents and rogue operatives meet to discuss possible action. The swaggering Foster (Robert Ryan) wants JFK dead, but the mysterious and powerful Ferguson (Will Geer) rebuffs the idea. Still, Farrington (Burt Lancaster) carries out a military training operation in preparation for an assassination while he waits for a decision.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Cassandra Crossing
programme.desc: Terrorists have planted a deadly virus on a transcontinental train. On board are the glamorous Jennifer Chamberlain (Sophia Loren) and her ex-husband, Dr. Jonathan Chamberlain (Richard Harris), as well as Nicole Dressler (Ava Gardner) and her young lover, Robby (Martin Sheen). They can't get off, and one solution proposed is to quarantine them by rerouting the train over the Cassandra Crossing -- an unstable bridge. Dr. Chamberlain wants to save them, but has to battle the terrorists first.

programme.title: Airport
programme.desc: In this large-ensemble disaster movie, Mel Bakersfeld (Burt Lancaster), the general manager of a Chicago-area airport, must contend with a massive snowstorm and other issues, both work-related and personal, while the troubled D.O. Guerrero (Van Heflin) threatens to blow up an airliner. As pilot Vernon Demerest (Dean Martin) attempts to calm Guerrero down and dissuade him from setting off explosives on the plane, tensions increase in the air and on the ground, and danger is imminent.

programme.title: Terres de volcans

Леопарди - игра на тронове S1 E2 Херцогът е тежко болен - нов мъжкар претендира за неговата територия и се опитва да убие младия Хосана и бебето Тлаламба.

Най-смъртоносните природни явления в света S2 E3 Две опустошителни земетресения удрят Мексико едно след друго, а австралийски преследвач на бури се озова в капан насред най-мощното торнадо, регистрирано някога в Ел Рино, Оклахома.

Гладиатори S1 E2 Австралия е земя, отделена от другите от времето на динозаврите; изолирана в продължение на милиони години, еволюцията е превърнала нейните животни в най-впечатляващите гладиатори на планетата.

Гладиатори S1 E1 Сухият сезон затяга хватката си върху малък водоем в голямата савана на Южна Африка; тук група гладиатори - големи и малки - са събрани в опасна близост.
Речни Чудовища S3 E2 Джереми е по следите на мистериозен човекоядец. Дали звярът е само легенда, или е същество от кръв и плът, което е нападнало водолази, отвлякло е дете и е погълнало живи овце?

Ягуарски хроники S1 E1 Отправяме се към Пантанал с Лизи и екипа в търсенето на изчезнал доминиращ мъжки ягуар; станете свидетели на битката между него и други млади мъжкари, надяващи се да спечелят местните женски.
Кораловият град S1 E4 С настъпването на зимата животът на оживения риф се забавя. Рифови акули и октоподи бродят наоколо, а е показан и коралов оазис върху стар потънал кораб.

Вулканични острови: горяща заплаха Около 10% от световното население живее близо до един от 1500-те активни вулкана на Земята. Във френските задморски територии обсерватории наблюдават вулканичната активност, за да защитят населението.

Дивата Словакия с Найджъл Марвен Словакия има планини, увенчани с приказни замъци с гледка към могъщия Дунав. Опознайте природата на тази малка държава, дом на вълци, рисове, над 1500 кафяви мечки и други невероятни животни.

programme.title: CSI: Den Tätern auf der Spur
programme.desc: Der junge Eric liegt seit Tagen nackt und mausetot in der Wüste. Starb er an einer Überdosis Drogen? Nicht der einzige Fall für Gil Grissom (William Petersen) nebst Team von der „Crime Scene Investigation“. Eine Lehrerin hat den Direktor erschlagen, und ein Bestatter buddelt Särge aus.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Kunststudentin Monica Dow (Kristina Apgar) findet ihre Zimmerkameradin Corinne ermordet am Pool auf. Beim Lügendetektortest wird klar, dass die begnadete Malerin etwas verbirgt. Horatio (David Caruso) findet heraus, dass Monica schizophren ist. Aber ist sie auch die Mörderin?

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Der Buchhalter Neal gerät in eine Barschlägerei und wird kurz darauf neben der Leiche seines Angreifers gesehen. Doch als das Team eintrifft, ist Neal samt dem Toten verschwunden. Horatio (David Caruso) und Kollegin Natalia (Eva La Rue) ermitteln in einem Fall, in dem bald nichts mehr so ist, wie es zunächst schien.

programme.title: Leverage

programme.title: Leverage
programme.desc: Nate und sein Team fühlen einem Düngemittelkonzern auf den Zahn. Er soll Schuld am Tod eines Mädchens sein. „Über den Wolken“ suchen die Gentlemangauner Beweise.

programme.title: 貨櫃大戰第2季:4
programme.desc: 該系列發生在商業航運港口，以一群來自不同背景的專家為中心，他們花費數万美元爭奪來自世界各地的高價航運集裝箱的內容。 由於只有幾分鐘的時間來評估集裝箱並決定是否出價，隨著他們大獲全勝或空手回家，壓力會越來越大。

programme.title: 心計第6季:14
programme.desc: 西蒙·貝克（Simon Baker）飾演派屈克·簡（Patrick Jane），一名受僱於加州調查局（California Bureau of Investigation，CBI）之獨立顧問。他利用出色的觀察技巧（如讀心術），成功偵破多宗大案。他過去經常使用所謂的心靈感應，曾假裝擁有通靈能力的靈媒而成名。派屈克·簡在一電視節目透露使用心靈感應協助警方調查連環殺手「紅約翰」（Red John），他的妻女因而被其殺害。在自責之下，他放棄作為騙人的靈媒，成為警方顧問。

programme.title: 卡那洛效應第3季:13
programme.desc: 麥可卡那洛是一個職業魔術師，卻是個愛開玩笑的人，他在一些很平常的場合裡，對一些猜想不到的人表演難解的魔術，全都被隱藏式攝影機拍下。

programme.title: 生活冷知識第2季:20
programme.desc: 歡迎來到由 Kevin Pereira 和 Brooke Van Poppelen 主持的每週節目，該節目以喜劇形式講述了永無止境的日常生活小貼士。 從學習如何用鞋子打開一瓶酒，到找出衛生紙捲的多種用途，永遠不乏有待發現的訣竅。 觀眾請注意：你們的生活將永遠不一樣。

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.sub-title: Flats Class - "The Hunt For Gobby Dick
programme.desc: CA returns to his old stomping grounds, chasing legend in familiar waters. Giants still roam here and feed on the smallest of offerings.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Marathon in the Florida Keys is home to some of the most unique fishing in the world, and on this episode of Local Knowledge we're experiencing it with one of the area's most respected captains. Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. Together they target awesome species including queen snapper, barrel-fish, snowy grouper, and tilefish. After action-packed day offshore, we unwind at the world-famous Hawks Cay Resort, one of the Florida Keys' premier destinations for anglers, families, and anyone looking to experience island life at its best.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: In this episode, Rush welcomes Cullen Lundholm from Cape Cod to experience Key West at its finest. Over several action-packed days, they target a variety of species in the incredible waters surrounding the Florida Keys. But the adventure doesn't end at the dock—Cullen also experiences Key West's world-class accommodations, exceptional food, and one-of-a-kind island lifestyle. From unforgettable fishing to first-class hospitality, this episode shows why Key West and the Florida Keys are among the world's premier fishing and vacation destinations.

programme.title: Sail Kings
programme.desc: The sharks won't stop Capt. Jared and special Guest Capt. Jimmy Hendricks from having their day.

programme.title: Captain's Log
programme.desc: Capt. Jonathan Moss is heading deep into the Everglades backcountry taking the Cayo 173 through the winding mangrove tunnels to the home countless Snook and Tarpon!
Adam and Logan Hays chase big bucks in the Buckeye State!
Tarif Alkhatib hunts a couple giant whitetails in his home state of Texas!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The Local Knowledge crew heads to Catalina Island off the coast of Southern California to participate in the 2024 War Heroes On Water tournament. This event offers a unique opportunity for the sport fishing community to create meaningful connections with our nation's heroes while raising awareness of the challenges they sometimes face when transitioning back to civilian life. With a little bit of luck and a lot of teamwork, Ali and Rush hope to put their veterans on a Bluefin tuna bite they won't forget!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Rush takes up an invite from good friend and fellow guide Jared Cyr to sight fish for barracuda and bonefish in the shallow waters of the Florida Keys. Meanwhile Rush's boat takes a break from charter fishing to get a new Seakeeper RIDE system installed.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: After a great trip fishing the flats, Rush returns the favor and extends an invite to friend Jarred Cyr fishing offshore. Fishing in Key West is all about the variety of species and opportunities they present. Mixing it up and taking advantage of this, the guys decide to see how many species they can catch using light spin and fly tackle offshore.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.sub-title: Local Knowledge - "Return to Casa Vieja Lodge
programme.desc: The LK crew returns to Guatemala with more friends for our yearly dose of world class fishing! Year after year, Casa Vieja Lodge continues to impress with daily shots at sailfish, marlin, mahi, and tuna. Tag along on our 2nd annual group trip for a tropical fishing experience like no other!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.sub-title: Hunting Land Man - "Two More Turkeys Down in Mississippi!!!
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and his son take on the turkey woods for an afternoon hunt. Although the woods remained quiet, a tom soon snuck out of the woods and on the end of Bentley's barrel! After that Slade was able to help a client of his harvest his first turkey! And boy was it an action packed hunt! Jakes, hens, and tons of gobbles, This hunt is spectacular! Lastly, Slade introduces a property that we have already made a video on, but with just how amazing the land is, we had to include it! Floweree is the epitome of a sportsman's paradise!

programme.desc: Mo Rocca of "CBS News Sunday Morning" hosts this series that celebrates inventors, including historic pioneers and forward-looking visionaries of the present. Featured segments include "What If It Never Happened," "The Innovation by Accident" and a focus on "junior genius
